## About
Kindry Kirbo is a chiropractor in Houston who focuses on Body Tempering, a soft tissue technique that uses weighted steel rollers to apply slow, sustained compression to muscles. It is meant for tight backs, hips, shoulders and the hard-to-release spots that keep coming back.
Every session starts with a short check-in. We talk through what feels restricted, look for the areas contributing to it, then work slowly so tissue has time to adapt instead of bracing harder. You leave with simple next steps for hydration, movement and follow-up if you need it.
The practice is at Willow Chase Blvd in Houston and holds a 5 rating from 20 Google reviews.

## Services
- Body tempering session: Chiropractor-led sessions where a weighted steel roller is placed over targeted muscles while you stay relaxed, with pressure adjusted as you go.
- Consultation: We discuss your symptoms and health history, do a movement assessment and examination, and decide whether body tempering fits your goals.
- Recovery after training: For people who feel chronically tight after workouts, want to move better before exercise, or have areas that stay stiff.

## FAQ
Q: Does body tempering hurt?
A: Expect firm pressure, but it should stay tolerable. The amount of weight and how long it is applied are adjusted to your comfort.

Q: How long does a session take?
A: It depends on your goals and the areas being worked on. We go over the recommended approach during your consultation.

Q: Can treatment start at my first visit?
A: If it is appropriate, treatment may begin the same day or become part of a personalized care plan based on your exam.

Q: Is body tempering right for everyone?
A: Not always. People with certain medical conditions, recent injuries or blood clotting disorders should be evaluated first, which is what the consultation is for.
